reasoning: Step-by-step analysis: 1) The syllabus spans 10 days, each day acting as a distinct unit/module. 2) Each day has a clear theme (e.g., Arrays, Hashing, Binary Search) with sub-topics listed under it. 3) Days 1-5 cover foundational patterns (Arrays, Hashing, Prefix Sum, Two Pointers, Sliding Window Basics). 4) Days 6-7 cover advanced string and greedy patterns. 5) Days 8-9 cover Binary Search (basic then advanced). 6) Day 10 is a revision/mixed day. 7) Each day is treated as one unit, and its bullet-point topics become individual topic entries. 8) Estimated hours per topic are derived from the stated 2-3 hrs/day budget distributed across the number of topics per day, weighted slightly higher for complex or advanced topics.
